Independent · Data-driven · No affiliation

Indian stock brokers, compared on published facts - nothing else.

We compare 16 Indian brokers using only figures they publish themselves or that appear in top-ranked published comparisons, with a source for every number. When a broker doesn't publish something, we say Not Disclosed - we never estimate, infer or invent a figure, and no broker gets preferential treatment.
